# Sarkari Aavedan (सरकारी आवेदन)

> Real-time portal for the latest Indian government jobs, exam results, admit cards, answer keys, syllabus, and admissions.

## Core Navigation

- [Home](https://sarkariavedan.info/) - Homepage showing categories grid, news ticker, and featured recruitment boards.
- [Latest Jobs](https://sarkariavedan.info/latest-jobs) - Direct notifications, active vacancies, and application links.
- [Admit Card](https://sarkariavedan.info/admit-card) - Official entrance tickets and call letters download.
- [Result](https://sarkariavedan.info/result) - Exam selection lists, results, and marks sheets.
- [Answer Key](https://sarkariavedan.info/answer-key) - Official provisional and final key sheets.
- [Syllabus](https://sarkariavedan.info/syllabus) - Detailed syllabus outlines and exam patterns.
- [Admission](https://sarkariavedan.info/admission) - Entrance test application forms for universities and boards.
- [Certificate Verification](https://sarkariavedan.info/certificate) - CCC forms, document verification dates, and scholarship links.
- [Outsourcing Jobs](https://sarkariavedan.info/outsourcing-offline) - Contractual and offline offline vacancies.
- [Important Notices](https://sarkariavedan.info/important) - General declarations, guidelines, and voter forms.

## Information Pages

- [About Us](https://sarkariavedan.info/about) - Information regarding the Sarkari Aavedan job portal team.
- [Contact Us](https://sarkariavedan.info/contact) - Contact form and email channels.
- [Disclaimer](https://sarkariavedan.info/disclaimer) - Terms of use, official sources reference, and warning.
- [Privacy Policy](https://sarkariavedan.info/privacy) - Privacy policies, cookie statements, and visitor rights.
